verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken strip layout: the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill the same size as the Free Entry/All Ages/Tastings tags, so it is buried. 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the headline, which breaks the reading order. The legal line is illegibly small, the phone is jammed against the top and right edges, and the date/time block floats off the central axis. B is slightly worse: its date is pushed right up against the 'Sunset Sessions' baseline, and its 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' and time lines are enlarged, which adds more competing focal points.
